faq.title: Frequently asked questions
faq.subtitle: Everything you might want to know before you publish your first service.

items.a: Yes — while the service is new, it’s completely free: create your account, publish services, and take bookings at no cost. Down the road we may introduce a paid subscription at a symbolic price, but you can get started for free today.

items.q: Do my guests need to install an app or create an account?
items.a: No. Guests open your link, pick a slot, and confirm with their messenger login and a name. There’s no separate app to download and no password to remember.
Not yet. Prices are shown as text on your services so guests know the cost, but payment happens the way you already collect it. Booking is about reserving the seat.

items.q: How do guests and I get notified?
items.a: Confirmations, cancel links, and new-booking alerts arrive in the messenger you and your guests already use — each new booking pings you with a deep link to your cabinet.

items.q: Can a slot ever be overbooked?
items.a: No. Every slot has a seat count and bookings are claimed atomically, so once a class is full it stops accepting bookings — no double-booking.

items.q: What if a guest needs to cancel?
items.a: Guests manage their booking from a secure link. The moment they cancel, the seat is released and becomes available to someone else.

terms.metaDescription: The terms that govern your use of CountMeIn.
terms.title: Terms of Service
terms.intro: These terms govern your use of CountMeIn. They outline the agreement between CountMeIn and the organizers who publish bookable services on the platform, as well as the guests who book them.
terms.usingBody: CountMeIn lets organizers publish services with time slots and capacity, and lets guests book those slots without creating an account. You are responsible for the accuracy of the services, prices, and availability you publish.
terms.bookingsBody: Prices shown are informational labels only — CountMeIn does not process payments in this release. Capacity is enforced per slot; once a slot is full, no further bookings are accepted for it.
terms.guestDataBody: Guests provide a display name and authenticate with their messenger account to book. You agree to handle guest details responsibly and only for the purpose of delivering the booked service.
terms.cancellationsBody: Guests may cancel from their secure management link. Cancelling releases the reserved seats back to the slot immediately.
terms.changesBody: We may update these terms as the product evolves. Continued use after changes take effect constitutes acceptance of the revised terms.

privacy.metaDescription: How CountMeIn handles organizer and guest data.
privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.intro: This privacy policy describes the data CountMeIn collects and how it is used.
privacy.collectBody: For organizers: name, messenger account, timezone, and the services and slots you publish. For guests: display name and messenger account, used to confirm and manage a booking.
privacy.useBody: Messenger accounts are verified through the Messenger Login Widget at booking time — no one-time codes or passwords are collected. We use your messenger account to deliver booking confirmations and cancellation links. We do not sell personal data.
privacy.analyticsBody: We use PostHog for product analytics (page views, feature usage) and Sentry for error monitoring (crash reports and performance traces). PostHog session recordings are enabled with all input fields masked, so no typed personal data appears in recordings. Signed-in organizers are identified by an internal id so their activity can be grouped; guests are not identified in analytics. Neither service receives your messenger credentials.
privacy.analyticsCookies: Analytics cookies are off by default and load only after you accept them in the cookie banner; if you reject or ignore it, PostHog is never initialized and no analytics cookies are set. Essential cookies required for sign-in and booking are always active and do not require consent. Sentry error monitoring runs without cookies. You can change your choice at any time by clearing this site's data in your browser.
privacy.retentionBody: Booking records are retained so organizers can view their history. Guests can cancel a booking at any time from their management link.
privacy.contactBody: Questions about privacy can be directed to the organizer you booked with, or to the CountMeIn team.
